# =============================================================================
#  COD3 Recomp - build for the host executable and the recompiled game code
#
#  Produces COD3.exe plus the recompiled_call_of_duty_3 library that contains
#  every translated PowerPC function.
#
#  This project is driven entirely by generated sources:
#    * build/ppc/*.cpp            - XenonRecomp output (3.1M lines)
#    * build/runtime/*.cpp        - kernel stubs generated by tools/gen_import_stubs.py
#  Regenerate both with tools/build.ps1 before configuring.
# =============================================================================

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

project(COD3Recomp LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# The generated code is huge; keep symbol and debug work to a minimum in the
# default build so the link stays tractable.
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Where the generated sources live
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

set(COD3_REPO_ROOT  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/..")
set(COD3_PPC_DIR    "${COD3_REPO_ROOT}/build/ppc")
set(COD3_RT_DIR     "${COD3_REPO_ROOT}/build/runtime")

foreach(required "${COD3_PPC_DIR}/ppc_recomp_shared.h"
                 "${COD3_PPC_DIR}/ppc_func_mapping.cpp"
                 "${COD3_PPC_DIR}/ppc_recomp.40.cpp"
                 "${COD3_RT_DIR}/kernel_imports_stubs.cpp")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${required}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "Missing generated source: ${required}\n"
            "Run tools/build.ps1 to generate the recompilation first.")
    endif()
endforeach()

# XenonUtils comes from the XenonRecomp checkout. It supplies the XEX loader
# (decrypt + decompress + import thunk patching) and the PPC context header.
set(XENONRECOMP_DIR "${COD3_REPO_ROOT}/.tools/XenonRecomp" CACHE PATH
    "Path to a XenonRecomp checkout")

set(XENONUTILS_DIR  "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/XenonUtils")
set(SIMDE_DIR       "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/simde")
set(DISASM_DIR      "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/disasm")

if(NOT EXISTS "${XENONUTILS_DIR}/ppc_context.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "XenonRecomp checkout not found at ${XENONRECOMP_DIR}.\n"
        "Run tools/setup.ps1 to fetch it.")
endif()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The recompiled game code
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

file(GLOB COD3_PPC_SOURCES "${COD3_PPC_DIR}/ppc_recomp.*.cpp")
file(GLOB COD3_PPC_HEADERS "${COD3_PPC_DIR}/*.h")

# ppc_func_mapping.cpp is the guest-address -> host-function table; it must be
# compiled into the same library as the functions it names.
list(APPEND COD3_PPC_SOURCES "${COD3_PPC_DIR}/ppc_func_mapping.cpp")

list(LENGTH COD3_PPC_SOURCES COD3_PPC_COUNT)
message(STATUS "COD3: compiling ${COD3_PPC_COUNT} recompiled translation units")

add_library(recompiled_call_of_duty_3 STATIC
    ${COD3_PPC_SOURCES}
    ${COD3_PPC_HEADERS}
    ${COD3_RT_DIR}/kernel_imports_stubs.cpp
    runtime/cod3_runtime.h
    runtime/crash_handler.cpp
    runtime/crt_thread_block.cpp
    runtime/guest_entry_counters.cpp
    runtime/heap_fault_tolerance.cpp
    runtime/heap_grow_method.cpp
    runtime/gpu_command_processor.cpp
    runtime/nt_file_io.cpp
    runtime/kernel_imports_core.cpp
    runtime/mm_physical.cpp
    runtime/ppc_runtime.cpp
    runtime/simde_compat.cpp)

target_include_directories(recompiled_call_of_duty_3
    PUBLIC
        "${COD3_PPC_DIR}"
        # cod3_stub_symbols.h is generated here by tools/gen_stub_symbols.py,
        # alongside kernel_imports_stubs.cpp.
        "${COD3_RT_DIR}"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime"
        # simde provides <x86/avx.h> and friends, which ppc_context.h includes;
        # it has to be PUBLIC because the host includes ppc_context.h too.
        "${SIMDE_DIR}"
        "${XENONUTILS_DIR}"
    PRIVATE
        "${DISASM_DIR}"
        "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/libmspack"
        "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/libmspack/libmspack"
        "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/tiny-AES-c"
        "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/TinySHA1")

target_compile_definitions(recompiled_call_of_duty_3
    PRIVATE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)


# The XEX loader (Xex2LoadImage) is built as part of XenonUtils so that the
# runtime parses the executable exactly the way XenonRecomp did.
# xex_patcher.cpp is included for one reason: it is where XenonUtils defines
# lzxDecompress(), which xex.cpp calls for LZX-compressed XEX containers.
target_sources(recompiled_call_of_duty_3 PRIVATE
    "${XENONUTILS_DIR}/xex.cpp"
    "${XENONUTILS_DIR}/image.cpp"
    "${XENONUTILS_DIR}/memory_mapped_file.cpp"
    "${XENONUTILS_DIR}/xex_patcher.cpp"
    "${XENONUTILS_DIR}/disasm.cpp"
    "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/libmspack/libmspack/mspack/lzxd.c"
    "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/tiny-AES-c/aes.c")

target_include_directories(recompiled_call_of_duty_3 PRIVATE
    "${DISASM_DIR}"
    "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/libmspack"
    "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/libmspack/libmspack"
    # libmspack's sources include their headers as <mspack.h>, <lzx.h> etc.,
    # and all of those live in this mspack/ subdirectory.
    "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/libmspack/libmspack/mspack"
    "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/tiny-AES-c"
    "${XENONRECOMP_DIR}/thirdparty/TinySHA1")

# Only the translation units we actually wrote get full optimisation and
# warnings; the 3.1M lines of generated code are compiled -O1 -g0 to keep the
# build time and memory footprint of the recompile tractable.
set_source_files_properties(
    runtime/kernel_imports_core.cpp
    runtime/ppc_runtime.cpp
    "${COD3_RT_DIR}/kernel_imports_stubs.cpp"
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2")

set_source_files_properties(${COD3_PPC_SOURCES}
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O1")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Host executable
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

add_executable(COD3 host/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(COD3 PRIVATE recompiled_call_of_duty_3)
target_compile_definitions(COD3 PRIVATE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)

set_target_properties(COD3 PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${COD3_REPO_ROOT}/build/host")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Debugging aids
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Produce a PDB for the host so the launch path can be stepped through.
target_link_options(COD3 PRIVATE /DEBUG)

message(STATUS "COD3: guest sources  ${COD3_PPC_DIR}")
message(STATUS "COD3: XenonRecomp    ${XENONRECOMP_DIR}")
